card.name: Punctuation after mailing-list and web prompts
card.fires_on: The small word or punctuation mark right after 'list', 'mailing list', 'logging in' or 'check' in website calls to action. It also fires on a repeated digit 4 inside numbers.

modes.label: Web call to action
modes.description: A comma, period, 'to' or 'at' right after a mailing list, login or discussion list phrase.
modes.example: Join our mailing list<< to>> keep up-to-date with our latest news

modes.label: Digit 4 in numbers
modes.description: The digit 4 inside a volume number or a table of numbers.

card.plain: It marks the small word or mark that follows a 'join our list' or 'log in' website prompt, and sometimes a digit 4 in a number.
